notes.title: Nectarmare 2.0.7
notes.notes: Now Nectarmare 2.07 is here in this version, some smaller errors have been fixed, and our dialogue in cut scenes has been grammatically corrected

notes.title: Hotfix in backend
notes.notes:
-A small change has been implemented to Leader Boards in backend
-Leader board for level 17 now works as intended

notes.title: Hotfix 5
notes.notes: # Fixed small graphical issues and fixed an issue where the boss were not appearing correctly sometimes

notes.title: Hotfix 4
notes.notes:
A couple of small updates

#  Inside the "How to play " guide instructions are now unlocking correctly when they  are first encountered.
# Fixed a graphic issue where the effect from taking a point (Nectar) would overlay settings UI when opening the Paus menu during play.

notes.title: Hotfix 3
notes.notes: # The creep intensity of level 11 has increased a bit

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.notes:
# Fixed a bug that made the bombs to not Spawn correctly during a crisis event
# Fixed an issue causing the boss level to crash on reload

notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.notes: #Leaderboards now sync to correctly named ones when uploading scores to steam. Before, the leaderboards were named after the backend naming of levels we have now changed that so that the steam leaderboards and the leaderboards in game both are named numerically. Hopefully this makes it easier to identify and compare ones high score
